metadata.description: Neo — a concept-to-production multi-agent coding system. A core crew, optional product and architecture-assessment crews, and additive per-stack plugins, for GitHub Copilot CLI.

plugins.name: neo-core
plugins.description: Coordinated coding-agent crew — a business-engineer orchestrator for the Specification loop and a technical-engineer orchestrator (+ researcher, implementation-planner, code-writer, code-reviewer) for the Coding loop, plus the feature-agent/task-planner specification crew, with lifecycle-logging hooks.

plugins.name: neo-product
plugins.description: Upstream product-engineering crew — a Product Engineer coordinating parallel Product Researchers plus Product Coach (viability), Design Thinking (desirability), and Systems Thinking (feasibility) specialists, ending in a PRD, with lifecycle-logging hooks.

plugins.name: neo-arc
plugins.description: Architecture-assessment crew — an Architecture Engineer orchestrator coordinating a scout, parallel readers, three independent designers, a three-lens judge panel, a synthesizer, one refuter per load-bearing reuse claim, a completeness critic, a report writer, and three fact-checkers, ending in an evidence-backed assessment report, with lifecycle-logging hooks.
